text: full TIVITA cube roughly 123 MB. surveying archive rarely want samples, read header alone — 12-byte read regardless file size. header carries width, height bands. title: Reading TIVITA recordings with tivis.r
text: TIVITA publish specification. layout implemented determined empirically validated Suite’s _RGB-Image.png exports: correlating band real recording greyscale reference peaks band 12, .e. 555 nm, human photopic luminous efficiency peaks. Competing hypotheses — band-sequential storage, transposed spatial axes — score near zero. matters failure mode silent. array() recycles without complaint, reader wrong dimensions sample type still returns full-size cube; simply noise. tivis_read_header() therefore checks file size header refuses guess.

title: tivis.r
text: TIVITA publish specification, format determined empirically: header decodes 640, 480, 100 file size equals 12 + 640 × 480 × 100 × 4 exactly. Big-endian float32 gives physically plausible reflectance non-finite values; little-endian gives thousands NaN. two ordering questions settled measuring sample stream directly rather guessing. Autocorrelation raw stream peaks lag 100 (r = 0.95) — band count — harmonics 200, 300 400, signature band interleaving pixel. Autocorrelation single extracted band plane peaks lag 480 (r = 0.99), image height, r = 0.43 lag 640, width: pixels run columns, across rows. Rendering ordering produces sharp clinical image; every combination produces tiling, striping noise.

title: tivis.r
text: earlier version README claimed layout validated r = 0.86 Suite’s _RGB-Image.png. wrong, worth recording. figure came correlating downsampled images, reference dominated horizontal structure survives horizontal tiling — image tiled four times across still scored 0.86. vendor PNG turned unusable ground truth anyway: rendered different size, carries title bar, rotated relative cube, even correct layout correlates roughly zero. thing actually settled format looking image, measuring sample stream’s periodicity — reference required. Getting wrong easy miss, array() recycles silently: reader wrong ordering still returns full-size, plausible-looking cube. tivis_read_header() therefore validates file size header, tests pin x/y mapping asymmetric feature rather round-tripping writer reader — let earlier error pass green suite.

title: tivis.r: Read Diaspective Vision TIVITA Hyperspectral Recordings — tivis.r-package
text: Reads hyperspectral imaging data written Diaspective Vision TIVITA Suite, used intraoperative tissue perfusion imaging. Parses binary 'SpecCube.dat' container (big-endian float32 samples band-interleaved--pixel order behind 12-byte dimension header), German-language acquisition metadata log, parameter images Suite exports alongside recording (oxygenation, NIR perfusion, tissue haemoglobin water indices). Requires vendor SDK contains compiled code. Companion 'cuvis.r', covers Cubert snapshot cameras, data source 'hyperspectR'.

title: tivis.r 0.1.0
text: tivis_read_cube() reads *_SpecCube.dat container returns (rows, cols, bands) array wavelengths attribute, matching convention used hyperspectR::hsi_cube(). Supports reading subset bands. tivis_read_header() decodes 12-byte dimension header without touching samples, large archives can scanned cheaply. validates file size header errors mismatch rather returning silently recycled array. tivis_get_metadata() parses Suite’s *_meta.log: INI dialect German section names, latin1 encoding comma decimal separators. Values coerced numerics logicals appropriate. tivis_reference_images() locates parameter maps Suite exports beside capture (RGB, oxygenation, NIR perfusion, THI, TWI, OHI). tivis_list_measurements() walks archive returns one row per recording. tivis_measurement() bundles cube, wavelengths, metadata, references timestamp single capture.

title: tivis.r 0.1.0
text: container undocumented vendor. layout implemented — big-endian float32, band-interleaved--pixel, pixels column-major y varying fastest, behind three big-endian uint32 dimensions, 500–995 nm axis 5 nm steps — established measuring sample stream’s periodicity. Autocorrelation raw stream peaks lag 100 (r = 0.95), band count, harmonics 200/300/400: band interleaving pixel. Autocorrelation extracted band plane peaks lag 480 (r = 0.99), image height, versus r = 0.43 lag 640, width: pixels run columns. development briefly documented row-major strength correlation Suite’s RGB export. incorrect — comparison made downsampled images, tiling artefact exposed averaged away. vendor PNG rotated rescaled relative cube usable pixel-level ground truth.
